                      Job description    
                    
                    
                      
                    
                    
                        Greetings from Shearwater Health..!! 

  Job Location -    Chennai (Guindy - Work from Office)  

  Job Title:  ML / Integration Engineer
  Employment Type:  Full-Time
  Department:  Information Technology

   We are hiring a   ML Engineer with 4+ years of experience   in ssoftware development, ML engineering, or AI integration. Experience working in the US Healthcare domain is mandatory. 

  If you have the required skills and are interested in this opportunity, please share your updated resume at  dsai@swhealth.com.  

  Please refer to the Job Description below for more details.  

  Role Purpose 

 The ML / Integration Engineer is responsible for integrating Machine Learning and AI solutions into enterprise applications, developing scalable APIs, automating MLOps processes, and ensuring secure, reliable, and compliant deployment of AI technologies. The role collaborates closely with Data Science, Engineering, DevOps, and business teams to deliver impactful AI-driven solutions.

  Key Responsibilities 

  AI/ML Integration & Engineering 

  Integrate ML models into web, mobile, and enterprise applications.  Design and develop APIs, microservices, and automation workflows.  Deploy and manage AI/ML solutions across AWS, Azure, or GCP environments.  Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and MLOps frameworks.  Monitor model performance, availability, scalability, and model drift.  Implement security controls, governance standards, and compliance requirements.  Integrate advanced AI capabilities including LLMs, Generative AI, NLP, and Computer Vision.  Troubleshoot and optimize AI solutions for performance and reliability.  Maintain technical documentation and deployment standards.    Business & Project Support 

  Gather, analyze, and document business and technical requirements.  Translate requirements into functional specifications and user stories.  Support project planning, Agile ceremonies, prioritization, and change management.  Coordinate UAT, solution validation, defect tracking, and issue resolution.  Prepare reports, dashboards, training materials, and project documentation.  
  Qualifications 

  Education & Experience 

  Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.  5+ years of IT experience with at least 2 years in healthcare, health tech, payer/provider, or BPO environments.  4-8 years of experience in software development, AI/ML engineering, or system integration.  
  Technical Skills 

   Programming:  Python, Java, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript   ML Frameworks:  TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, FastAPI, Flask   Cloud Platforms:  AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform   Containers:  Docker, Kubernetes   APIs:  REST, GraphQL, gRPC   CI/CD:  Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps   Databases:  PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis   Messaging:  Kafka, RabbitMQ   Monitoring:  Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack   Tools:  Jira, Confluence, Visio, Excel, Power BI, Tableau  
  Preferred Certifications 

  PMP, PRINCE2  Agile/Scrum  ITIL  Lean Six Sigma  Cloud and AI/ML Certifications

Full Email Body:
The right answer is never from just one AI model

One key, a dozen models, and a build idea worth trying this week. ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌

Hi Hemachandiran . G,

“Is GPT better than Claude?”

That’s the wrong question. One model writes the better headline, another the more accurate summary, and picking a single winner throws away good work.

This Week’s Demo Project:

Ask three models the same question with KodeKey, then compare field by field, best title from one, best summary from another, best tags from a third.

Here’s how to build it.

The project

Vote Per Field, Not Per Answer

Step 1: Point the OpenAI client at KodeKey

Same library you already use. Only the URL changes.

client = OpenAI(

api_key=os.environ["KODEKEY_API_KEY"],

base_url="https://api.ai.kodekloudcom/v1",

)

Step 2: Ask every model the same thing

Ask for JSON so every reply has the same fields. That’s what makes them comparable.

MODELS = ["openai/gpt-4o-mini",

"anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5",

"google/gemini-2.5-flash"]

def ask(model):

r = client.chat.completions.create(

model=model,

messages=[{"role": "user", "content": PROMPT}],

response_format={"type": "json_object"},

)

return model, json.loads(r.choices[0].message.content)

with ThreadPoolExecutor(3) as pool:

answers = dict(pool.map(ask, MODELS))

Run them at the same time, not one after another. And catch errors per model, so one slow or failing model doesn’t stop the whole thing.

Step 3: Judge one field at a time

You can’t just count votes here. Three models will write three different titles, so nothing ever gets two votes. (Counting votes works fine when answers are short and exact: a total, a yes/no, a category.)

For writing, use a fourth model as a judge. Show it only one field, with one thing to look for.

for field, looking_for in RUBRIC.items():

options = {m: a[field] for m, a in answers.items()}

verdict = client.chat.completions.create(

model=JUDGE,                # a model that isn't being judged

messages=[{"role": "user", "content":

f"Pick the best one for: {looking_for}\n"

'Reply as JSON: {"winner": "<key>"}\n\n' + json.dumps(options)}],

response_format={"type": "json_object"},

)

best[field] = options[json.loads(verdict.choices[0].message.content)["winner"]]

If you can write a simple rule instead, shortest title that fits, tags that match your own list, use the rule. It’s free and it never changes its mind.

Step 4: Put it together

Save which model won each field. After a few runs you’ll see which models keep earning their spot, and which ones you can drop.

Two things to know before you use this

Pieces from different models can clash: a title about studio sound next to a summary about commuting. If the output is prose, run one last pass to smooth it out. It works best on separate facts: extracted data, labels, form fields.

It also costs more. Three answers plus a judge for every field. Worth it when a wrong field is expensive. Not worth it for a product blurb.

This is just one small experiment out of dozens you can run on KodeKey. Go ahead and try it yourself.

  Please find the job description for the role: 

 We are seeking a detail-oriented Pharmaceutical Analyst with 2-15 years of experience to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in analytical chemistry and a passion for ensuring the quality and safety of pharmaceutical products. This role involves conducting rigorous testing, analyzing data, and collaborating with various departments to drive product excellence in compliance with global regulatory standards.

 
 Responsibilities: 

   Conduct analytical testing and validation of pharmaceutical products to ensure compliance with regulatory standards.

   Analyze data from experiments and studies to prepare reports and presentations for stakeholders.

   Collaborate with cross-functional teams including R&D, quality assurance, and regulatory affairs to support product development.

   Maintain and calibrate laboratory equipment to ensure accuracy and reliability of test results.

   Monitor industry trends and regulatory changes to ensure compliance and inform strategic decisions.

   Assist in the development of standard operating procedures (SOPs) and best practices in laboratory processes.

   Participate in audits and inspections by regulatory bodies and ensure readiness for compliance checks.

   
 Skills and qualifications: 

   Bachelor's or Master's degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, or related field.

   Experience with analytical techniques such as HPLC, GC, and spectrophotometry.

   Strong understanding of Good Laboratory Practices (GLP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).

   Proficiency in data analysis software (e.g., SAS, R, or Python) and statistical methods.

   Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, for report writing and presentations.

   Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail in experimental design and execution.

   Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

   Familiarity with regulatory requirements specific to the pharmaceutical industry in Australia, Canada, Germany, New Zealand, or Singapore.

Subject: Your agents are running. Your controls aren't.
Email Snippet: To view this email as a web page, go to the following address: https://web.docker.com/index.php/email/emailWebview?mkt_tok=NzkwLVNTQi0zNzUAAAGjlbcsv-VlZgDHMfcCTfYdEiVgNJZFwrwGKIlGPuv6HGYOGJZjSi2BIASg624gVHIlcUlWRdbB0GYuffjrIiMOFCSwHsEZnznqgBpr_5Ek9AeB-Lq2  95% of organizations are already treating
Full Email Body:
To view this email as a web page, go to the following address: https://web.docker.com/index.php/email/emailWebview?mkt_tok=NzkwLVNTQi0zNzUAAAGjlbcsv-VlZgDHMfcCTfYdEiVgNJZFwrwGKIlGPuv6HGYOGJZjSi2BIASg624gVHIlcUlWRdbB0GYuffjrIiMOFCSwHsEZnznqgBpr_5Ek9AeB-Lq2

95% of organizations are already treating agents as a strategic priority. That’s from Docker's State of Agentic AI survey <https://em.docker.com/NzkwLVNTQi0zNzUAAAGjlbcsv7Eq2l86z6x1XXTVmHxovb1dDSGfnTNfXEh46ImWTxuhmbz0I03e0wAMoOGpSbvUX9Y=> of 800+ developers and decision-makers worldwide. 60% already have them in production. Executives are mandating adoption across every function, and the teams that move first will out-execute everyone else.

So why is adoption stalling?

Security. It's the top blocker for 40% of teams building agents today, and it compounds at every layer. Infrastructure teams need secure sandboxing and runtime isolation. Operations teams are dealing with orchestration sprawl that creates blind spots. And at the governance layer, 45% of organizations say the biggest challenge is ensuring tools are secure, trusted, and enterprise-ready.

MCP is making it harder, not easier. 85% of teams are familiar with the Model Context Protocol, and two thirds actively use it. But most are operating in leap-of-faith mode: adopting MCP without the security guarantees they would demand from any other enterprise infrastructure. 46% of teams in early stages cite MCP security and compliance as their top concern.

The next phase of agent adoption won't be won on speed. It’ll be won by the teams that build governance in from the start.

Full Email Body:
There's more under docker run than most interviews ask about.

What actually happens when you run a container, plus 30 real DevOps interview questions. ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌

Hi Hemachandiran . G,

Run docker run nginx and in under a second you’ve got a container. Most people can tell you that command works. Very few can tell you what actually happens between hitting enter and Nginx serving traffic.

This week’s watch breaks down exactly that: how Docker checks for the image locally, pulls it from a registry if it’s missing, and turns it into an isolated Linux process before your app even starts. Namespaces act as separate rooms while cgroups control what each container is allowed to consume, and that’s the piece most explainers skip.

The Process of Running a Container

The process of running a container video thumbnail (https://team.kodekloud.com/e3t/Ctc/2L+113/cQ4sL04/VVDNXv2j87rVW7n24p72_2WvBVDyhz95SBT9NMhPPSs3prCCW7Y8-PT6lZ3mvW5gHJw73NJDSpW8b6_4f6mw7SyW18lFyp8D2gGvW1yDZL63j5XzjW23pN5n5MSbzGW8mknXN2m4Gd4W2sckY73SW-ndN3kTGSk6_VhcW6JYsZ119WNDDW2XH2Vz30gvklW3jy2N930zDqyW5BL9sh30Wyk_VbG5307XlXpGW5vzW0R2Nf64QW8j4qG135ndmCW6xS3_L6q5LG5W35Xhf-76q2gVW1nsj1R4XB8FtVvXyWC160zxDW3vwX562zkQv0W3Vb_rl3Z8l69W4L3GTv9gvF1gW6NP85n2tyggfW7vzC1822cK_NW8CZVLK5QZ3HGW2dW1hW1793p3f8PQf6004 )

Prepping for DevOps interviews? We’ve got a full watchlist to help, 38 videos covering the questions that actually come up, from CI/CD pipelines to Kubernetes troubleshooting to system design. Bookmark it and work through a few before your next interview.

15 courses that take you from the fundamentals through containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and observability, ending with the Prometheus Certified Associate exam. One clear path instead of guessing what to learn next.

Explore the Path (https://team.kodekloud.com/e3t/Ctc/2L+113/cQ4sL04/VVDNXv2j87rVW7n24p72_2WvBVDyhz95SBT9NMhPPSs3prCCW7Y8-PT6lZ3prW979dV093SLBhN5mY9ws9h710W3-dYVV8lC8ftW5W_yR135lpB-W5tDC1h50FXBgW9dnr1j1l0mQzW4f3zP51psgWSN92xlmXb-6vNW62P8ww3wPDnfW3Sfwfr8xnmPsW5lcnXj5Fvb8BF4vnzbGqDVLMQvpzcdfVxqW5rsg9w4kBKs9W4Yqlf-30LtDTW8KxfPc8rvhpPW8qGnCm7m-yT9W5K_nq-5l-ntzW38K-_y8Ymqb-W3bnx3V7tBGKkN9blD_FXDh8QW1pXkYF4lxFzfVXMXVj66SpFPW3PYDhC4FH55_W5lFmXq4ZrVHBW9hQxP376f5rsf6NGrV204 )  → (https://team.kodekloud.com/e3t/Ctc/2L+113/cQ4sL04/VVDNXv2j87rVW7n24p72_2WvBVDyhz95SBT9NMhPPSs3prCCW7Y8-PT6lZ3prW979dV093SLBhN5mY9ws9h710W3-dYVV8lC8ftW5W_yR135lpB-W5tDC1h50FXBgW9dnr1j1l0mQzW4f3zP51psgWSN92xlmXb-6vNW62P8ww3wPDnfW3Sfwfr8xnmPsW5lcnXj5Fvb8BF4vnzbGqDVLMQvpzcdfVxqW5rsg9w4kBKs9W4Yqlf-30LtDTW8KxfPc8rvhpPW8qGnCm7m-yT9W5K_nq-5l-ntzW38K-_y8Ymqb-W3bnx3V7tBGKkN9blD_FXDh8QW1pXkYF4lxFzfVXMXVj66SpFPW3PYDhC4FH55_W5lFmXq4ZrVHBW9hQxP376f5rsf6NGrV204 )

DevOps Interview Questions 2026: A Practical Prep Guide

Subject: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
Email Snippet: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning [https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/ai-data-science/foundation-models/nemotron/] is now available on Ollama, and it runs completely on your own device. It’s a 30 billion parameter (3B active) open model from NVIDIA built for agents that stay running: gathering context, call
Full Email Body:
NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning [https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/ai-data-science/foundation-models/nemotron/] is now available on
Ollama, and it runs completely on your own device. It’s a 30 billion parameter (3B active) open model from NVIDIA built for agents
that stay running: gathering context, calling tools, and working through multi-step tasks.
 
Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is made for agentic tasks such as reading a file, calling a tool, sorting a result, and retrying something
that failed. Most of these steps don’t need a large model. At 3B active parameters per token, it’s built for local systems rather
than the datacenter, and running locally means your data stays on your device.


Model highlights

 * Runs where you work: 30B total parameters with only 3B active per token, on a hybrid Mixture-of-Experts architecture. It runs
   locally on NVIDIA RTX PCs [https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/ai-on-rtx/], NVIDIA RTX PRO workstations
   [https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/products/workstations/], NVIDIA DGX Spark
   [https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/products/workstations/dgx-spark/] and DGX Station
   [https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/products/workstations/dgx-station/], and in the datacenter and cloud.

 * Built for agent harnesses: developed with the Nemotron Coalition and trained for the tools developers already use, across
   coding, tool calling, instruction following and multi-turn work.

 * 1M token context

 * Optimized inference: speculative decoding using multi-token prediction (MTP), DFlash or DSpark, offering up to 4x higher
   throughput than comparable open models.

 * Yours to customize: an open model trained on open datasets. Post-train it for a specific task and run the result anywhere, from
   edge to datacenter.


What you can build

Nemotron 3.5 Lightning excels on the following workloads:
 * Long-running personal assistants. Email, calendar, projects and bookings. Running locally, the agent can use local context and
   none of it is sent elsewhere.

 * Coding sub-agents. Running tests, searching the codebase and applying refactors, inside the harnesses you already use.

 * Security operations. Enriching alerts, classifying incidents, querying logs, correlating indicators and preparing structured
   findings for analysts.

 * A local tier alongside the cloud. Nemotron 3.5 Lightning handles the high-volume steps locally, and a larger hosted model picks
   up the few that need one. Same CLI, same API.

 * A specialist you train yourself. Open weights and open datasets, so you can post-train Nemotron 3.5 Lightning for one narrow
   job and run the result locally.


Get started

Download Ollama [https://ollama.com/download], then run Nemotron 3.5 Lightning with your tool of choice.
 
General chat
ollama run nemotron-3.5-lightning
 
Claude Code
ollama launch claude --model nemotron-3.5-lightning
 
OpenClaw
ollama launch openclaw --model nemotron-3.5-lightning
 
Hermes Agent
ollama launch hermes --model nemotron-3.5-lightning
 
OpenCode
ollama launch opencode --model nemotron-3.5-lightning
 
For users on Apple silicon, Ollama offers the model with state-of-the-art performance: nemotron-3.5-lightning:30b-mlx.
 
See more integrations [https://ollama.com/library/nemotron-3.5-lightning] on the model page.
 
The same pattern works for models running in Ollama’s cloud, so an agent can send an individual step to a larger model without
changing anything else.

** 1.9.24 Hotfix Released
------------------------------------------------------------

Salad version 1.9.24 fixes a crash which caused some container workloads to repeatedly fail and restart, interrupting Chopping.

This issue has been reported widely across the network. If you've been having issues, then we recommend updating to this version as soon as possible.
------------------------------------------------------------

If you have problems with 1.9.24, please submit a support ticket (https://support.salad.com/)  or email us directly via support@salad.com. Please include a detailed description and your most recent logs.

You're also welcome to join the Salad Discord (https://discord.com/invite/salad) and speak directly with the team about what's happening on your machine.
Update Here (https://salad.com/download)

Happy Chopping,
The Salad Chefs

Welcome to Your Latest myGwork's Newsletter: Travel and Relocation
==================================================================

**Global mobility only works when it works for everyone.**


Pride Month is behind us, but for LGBTQ+ professionals relocating across borders, the realities don't pause.


Every week, employees are asked to relocate or travel internationally, often without knowing if the destination is safe, welcoming, or even legal. The numbers matter: 66 jurisdictions still criminalise same-sex relations, 12 retain the death penalty, and 13 criminalise trans identity or expression. Only around 40 jurisdictions have marriage equality, meaning a "spouse and dependants" relocation package quietly excludes many employees before the paperwork's even open. And the map keeps shifting: Niger and Senegal introduced new criminal provisions in 2026, following Burkina Faso and Mali (2024/2025).


This is where employers make the difference. We're encouraged to see partners mapping LGBTQ+ safety into travel policies, building relocation support around local laws and partner recognition, and equipping HR teams to have these conversations properly. Across the myGwork network, 450 partner employers are actively recruiting in 33 markets that criminalise same-sex relations, doing the work where it matters most.


At myGwork, we believe global mobility only works when it works for everyone: accurate guidance, relocation support that doesn't assume one-size-fits-all, and a culture where people can raise concerns without having to justify who they are.


From country briefings to inclusive mobility policies, we're here to help you build a workplace where every employee can move forward safely.

###LGBTQ+ Hiring Across Borders: download myGwork's guide

For more than two decades, global LGBTQ+ inclusion work could rely on one assumption: every year, the legal landscape would get a little easier. As myGwork’s latest 2026 guide on LGBTQ+ Hiring Across Borders shows, that assumption no longer holds.

[ Download Full Guide](https://nqt1t.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/28xHLtxYQ4yaodCgYYBsdE1G2plkSVsML3/H1yqPTuhbsKd)

A step-by-step guide to relocating abroad as an LGBTQ+ person - legal research, immigration pathways, healthcare continuity, safety, and community, all in one place.

Inclusive Hiring Across Boarders
================================

Building inclusive workplaces for LGBTQ+ employees across global markets means navigating varying legal protections, cultural attitudes, and regional risks. This session gives HR, Talent Acquisition, DE&I, and business leaders practical guidance on global workplace rights, inclusive recruitment strategies, and supporting talent across diverse regions. Learn how to balance your global inclusion commitments with local realities, wherever your workforce is based. 

[ Watch Recap](https://nqt1t.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/28xHLtxYQ50fUzrFch0Mj6ZbmSvCmJEi5B/BclsROB1ezfl)

**Travel and Relocation: Stories from LGBTQ+ Travellers**
=========================================================

From workplace relocation to leisure travel, LGBTQ+ individuals face unique challenges when navigating different regions and cultures. This panel will feature personal stories and expert insights on safety, inclusion, and advocacy for more inclusive travel experiences.


**What will you learn?**


- The challenges LGBTQ+ travellers face in different regions. 
- How to advocate for inclusive policies in travel and relocation. 
- Tips for ensuring safety and comfort while traveling as an LGBTQ+ person.

Full Email Body:
Muse Glimmer [https://ollama.com/library/muse-glimmer], Meta's newest open model and the first released by Meta Superintelligence
Labs, is now available on Ollama. Muse Glimmer is a 30B multimodal model built for agent workloads that run locally.
 

Download model [https://ollama.com/library/muse-glimmer]

 
With Ollama, you can use Muse Glimmer to power coding agent applications such as Claude Code, Codex, Pi and more, as well as
long-running personal assistants such as OpenClaw and Hermes.
 
To download and run Muse Glimmer locally, first download Ollama [https://ollama.com/download], then run:
 

ollama run muse-glimmer

 
Ollama's MLX engine provides state-of-the-art performance on Apple Silicon, with support for DFlash and image input:
 

ollama run muse-glimmer:30b-mlx


 


Power coding agents locally

To run Muse Glimmer with Claude Code, run:
 

ollama launch claude --model muse-glimmer

 
For a lighter-weight coding agent, try Pi [https://pi.dev]:
 

ollama launch pi --model muse-glimmer

 
For personal assistant frameworks such as OpenClaw and Hermes, use:
 

ollama launch openclaw --model muse-glimmer

 

ollama launch hermes --model muse-glimmer

 
ollama launch also works with Codex, OpenCode, Copilot, and more. See all integrations [https://docs.ollama.com/integrations].
 
Muse Glimmer also supports controllable reasoning strength: low, medium, high, and xhigh. Use high for complex coding and agentic
tasks, and lower strengths when speed matters more.
 


State-of-the-art multimodal performance on Apple Silicon

 
With Ollama 0.32.7, Ollama's MLX engine [https://ollama.com/blog/mlx-performance] now supports DFlash, building on previous
multi-token prediction (MTP) support [https://ollama.com/blog/faster-gemma-4-mlx-mtp] for 1.5-1.8x faster performance.
 
With new image input support in the MLX engine, coding agents can now perform low-latency, back-to-back tool calling on tasks that
require images, such as:
 * Building websites or applications from a drawing or mockup

 * Computer use applications powered by screenshots

 * Reading documents, receipts, and charts

 
If you have any feedback, reply directly to this email or join Ollama's Discord [https://discord.gg/ollama].
 
❤️ Ollama

              Windows quality: an update on the commitment we made in March 


        

        

        

        
	    
        

        

        
		
		
	  
    

									
								 
							 
						
						
						
							
								 
									 
										 
										
											 
												
												
													 
														 
														 
														 
														 In March, Pavan Davuluri, EVP for Windows + Devices, announced  our commitment to Windows quality . Four months in, we continue our work to deliver ongoing improvements customers can feel across performance, reliability, and craft. As we do that, we are going to keep listening and closing the loop on your feedback.


  Meeting Windows Insiders  in the last few months at our monthly meetups and hearing what you think has been one of the best parts. This is work our engineers love and we want you to feel it in the product. We know we have more to do, and we’re grateful to be on this journey with you.

														 Clearer results, a calmer home screen, removal of promotional content from web results, and prioritization of local search results are just a few of the updates to Windows Search Box that aim to make your experience faster and more relevant.

 These updates are gradually rolling out to Insiders in the Experimental channel.

Subject: Who is AI working for and who is it working against?
Email Snippet: EFFECTING CHANGE LIVESTREAM SERIES  Hi ​Digital Rights Supporter​,  The important thing about a technology isn’t just what it does: it’s who it does it for and who it does it to. Cory Doctorow and EFF Executive Director Nicole Ozer are tackling what needs to happen now to ensure AI actually works
Full Email Body:
EFFECTING CHANGE LIVESTREAM SERIES 
Hi ​Digital Rights Supporter​,

The important thing about a technology isn’t just what it does: it’s who it does it for and who it does it to. Cory Doctorow and EFF Executive Director Nicole Ozer are tackling what needs to happen now to ensure AI actually works for everyone, not just those in power.

​Join us this Wednesday at 10:00 am Pacific​ for the latest installment of our EFFecting Change Livestream Series: Who the Machine Serves. AI can help or harm people, and EFF was created to make sure it helps. We are at a critical juncture to ensure that AI is developed and used in ways that respect fundamental rights and works for those who build it, use it, and are affected by it. Find out more and bring your questions for this livestream with live Q&A.

EFFecting Change Livestream Series:
Who the Machine Serves
Wednesday, August 12
10:00 am - 11:00 am Pacific
RSVP TODAY: www.eff.org/livestream-eai
Livestream discussion followed by Q&A

We encourage you to join us live for this discussion, however it will be recorded and available following the event on YouTube (www.eff.org/EFfectingChangeRecordings) and the Internet Archive (www.eff.org/EFFectingChangeArchive)!

See you there, 

Melissa Srago 
EFF Membership Team 

P.S. Throughout 2026, EFF staff will host experts in their field that will dive into topics that are sure to spur questions and a desire for change. Check out​eff.org/EFFectingChange​ for the lineup! Want to make sure you don’t miss an announcement? Sign up for updates about this series at ​eff.org/ECUpdates​.

---------------------------

EFF is dedicated to a harassment-free experience for everyone, and all participants are encouraged to view our full ​Event Expectations​.

The Electronic Frontier Foundation is the leading nonprofit defending online civil liberties. We promote digital innovation, defend free speech, fight illegal surveillance, and protect rights and freedoms for all as our use of technology grows. Find out more at ​https://www.eff.org./

 Job Title: Senior Cloud Engineer  Azure

 Location: Bangalore (WFO)

 Experience: 5–6 years 

 Employment Type: Full-Time

 Role Overview

 We are seeking an experienced Senior Cloud Engineer – Azure to lead the design, deployment, and support of enterprise Azure environments. This role involves managing complex Azure infrastructure, handling advanced incident resolutions, driving automation initiatives, and providing technical leadership within the operations team.

 The ideal candidate has deep hands-on Azure expertise, strong troubleshooting capabilities, and the ability to support multi-customer Managed Services environments.

 Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Azure infrastructure operations and act as a senior technical escalation point for L2/L3 teams.  • Design, deploy, and manage Azure services including:  Virtual Machines, AV Sets/Zones, Load Balancers, Virtual Networks  Azure Storage, Azure Backup, ASR, Key Vault  Azure App Services, Functions, AKS (optional), Azure SQL (platform-level)  • Optimize performance, cost, security, and availability across Azure workloads.  • Manage identity and access using Azure AD / Entra ID, RBAC, Conditional Access.  • Implement and maintain monitoring solutions using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Alerts.  • Troubleshoot complex issues involving compute, networking, storage, OS, and security.  • Build and maintain automation solutions using PowerShell, Azure Automation, Logic Apps, or CI/CD pipelines.  • Review and implement Azure Policies, governance controls, tagging standards, and compliance requirements.  • Support DR strategies, backup validation, patching cycles, and BCP testing.  • Document architecture, configurations, runbooks, and best practices.  • Collaborate with security, network, DevOps, and application teams to ensure seamless cloud operations.  • Participate in shifts and on-call support for critical incidents.  • Mentor team members and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.   Technical Skills Required

  • Hands-on expertise with Azure IaaS/PaaS services:  VMs, VNets, NSG, Peering, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway  Azure Backup, Site Recovery, Key Vault, Azure Storage  App Services, Azure SQL, Load Balancers, App Gateway  • Strong understanding of Azure governance, cost management, RBAC, and security best practices.  • Advanced experience in PowerShell scripting, Azure Automation, and automation frameworks.  • Knowledge of ARM/Bicep/Terraform for infrastructure deployments (preferred).  • Strong Windows or Linux server administration background.  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps pipelines, Git, and YAML-based automation (nice-to-have).  • Experience with enterprise monitoring tools: Azure Monitor, Sentinel (optional), Grafana, etc.  • Understanding of ITIL processes and Managed Services operations.   Soft Skills

  • Strong leadership and decision-making ability.  • Excellent communication skills and customer-facing experience.  • Ability to manage high-severity incidents under pressure.  • Proactive, ownership-driven, and detail-oriented.  • Mentoring and capability-building mindset.   Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field.  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) required.  • Azure Solutions Architect (AZ-305) or Azure Security Engineer (AZ-500) preferred.  • ITIL Foundation certification is an advantage.   Work Environment

  • 24x7 Managed Services with rotational on-call responsibilities.  • Exposure to large-scale enterprise Azure deployments and modernisation programs.  • Opportunity to work closely with architects and lead cloud transformation initiatives.

Subject: your agent now lives inside FlutterFlow
Email Snippet: hey FlutterFlow builders!  two things just shipped that change how you build with AI agents in FlutterFlow.  your agent now lives inside FlutterFlow.  instead of switching between your editor, terminal, and browser, you can now work with your AI agent directly inside the FlutterFlow desktop ap
Full Email Body:
hey FlutterFlow builders!

two things just shipped that change how you build with AI agents in FlutterFlow.

your agent now lives inside FlutterFlow.

instead of switching between your editor, terminal, and browser, you can now work with your AI agent directly inside the FlutterFlow desktop app.

open the AI Agent, connect your existing local setup, and start building without leaving your project.
Open the Desktop app (https://flutterflow.io/desktop)

works with Claude Code and Codex.

plugins for Claude Code (https://github.com/FlutterFlow/flutterflow-claude) and Codex (https://github.com/FlutterFlow/flutterflow-codex) that work in the desktop and terminal apps. setup takes about a minute.

also shipped:

text selection: all text in your app is now selectable via App Settings > General > Display Settings.

canvas screenshots: the MCP tool can now screenshot the Builder canvas so your agent can see your design, no local run required.

PinCode animation: choose entry animation (Slide, Fade, Scale, or None) with custom curve and duration.

let us know what you build.

— the FlutterFlow team

Greetings from BSS Recruit!

Company Website - https://www.straive.com/

About BSS Recruit:

BSS Recruit, your dedicated companion for comprehensive and scalable digital talent solutions. We specialize in connecting you with tailored opportunities that align with your skills and aspirations. With a vast network of reputable clients, we prioritize your growth and success. Elevate your career path today with our dedicated support and expertise. Know more - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AePPA1Fa1Wc

Follow us - https://www.linkedin.com/company/bssrecruit



About our client:

Straive is a market-leading content and data technology company providing data services, subject-matter expertise, & technology solutions to multiple domains. Data Analytics & AI Solutions, Data AI-Powered Operations, and Education & Learning form the core pillars of the company’s long-term vision. The company is a specialized solutions provider to business information providers in finance, insurance, legal, real estate, life sciences, and logistics. Straive continues to be the leading content services provider to research and education publishers. Data Analytics & AI Services:

Our Data Solutions business has become critical to our client's success. We use technology and AI with human experts in the loop to create data assets that our clients use to power their data products and their end customers' workflows. As our clients expect us to become their future-fit analytics and AI partner, they look to us for help in building data analytics and AI enterprise capabilities for them. With a client base spanning 30 countries worldwide, Straive’s multi-geographical resource pool is strategically located in eight countries: India, the Philippines, the USA, Nicaragua, Vietnam, the United Kingdom, and the company headquarters in Singapore.

Straive is an equal opportunity employer. We commit to celebrating diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

Role Overview

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced AWS DevOps Engineer with strong expertise in AWS Cloud, CI/CD, Infrastructure Automation, Docker, Kubernetes, and DevOps practices. The candidate should have experience working in the Healthcare domain, supporting secure, highly available, scalable, and compliant applications and infrastructure.
Key Responsibilities

  *   Design, implement, and manage scalable and highly available AWS cloud infrastructure.
  *   Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for application deployment and release automation.
  *   Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Terraform / CloudFormation.
  *   Manage AWS services such as EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, EKS, ECS, Lambda, CloudWatch, and CloudTrail.
  *   Implement and manage Docker containers and Kubernetes/EKS environments.
  *   Configure and maintain Git, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or AWS CodePipeline.
  *   Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and performance optimization using CloudWatch, ELK, Prometheus, and Grafana.
  *   Implement security best practices including IAM, encryption, secrets management, network security, and access controls.
  *   Troubleshoot production issues and perform root cause analysis (RCA).
  *   Work closely with development, QA, security, and infrastructure teams to ensure reliable software delivery.
  *   Support Healthcare applications and data environments, ensuring security, availability, auditability, and compliance requirements.
  *   Participate in disaster recovery, backup, incident management, and business continuity activities.

                       Role/Job Title:  DevOps Engineer/ Senior DevOps Engineer

   Function/Department:  Information Technology

   Job Purpose: 

  We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced DevOps Engineer with a primary focus on AWS

  cloud services. The ideal candidate will be proficient in automated provisioning, cloud

  management, and possess expertise in tools such as Terraform and Packer. As a DevOps Lead,

  you will play a crucial role in designing, implementing, and maintaining our cloud infrastructure to

  ensure optimal performance, reliability, and scalability.

   Roles and Responsibilities: 

   AWS Cloud Management: Design, deploy, and manage AWS cloud infrastructure.

  Optimize and maintain cloud resources for performance and cost efficiency. Monitor and

  ensure the security of cloud-based systems.

   Automated Provisioning: Develop and implement automated provisioning processes for

  infrastructure deployment. Utilize tools like Terraform and Packer to automate and

  streamline the provisioning of resources.

   Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Champion the use of Infrastructure as Code principles.

  Collaborate with development and operations teams to define and maintain IaC scripts

  for infrastructure deployment and configuration.

   Collaboration and Communication: Work closely with cross-functional teams to

  understand project requirements and provide DevOps expertise. Communicate

  effectively with team members and stakeholders regarding infrastructure changes,

  updates, and improvements.

   Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD): Implement and maintain CI/CD

  pipelines to automate software delivery processes. Ensure reliable and efficient

  deployment of applications through the development lifecycle.

   Performance Monitoring and Optimization: Implement monitoring solutions to track

  system performance, troubleshoot issues, and optimize resource utilization. Proactively

  identify opportunities for system and process improvements.

   Mandatory Skills: 

   Proven experience as a DevOps Engineer or similar role, with a focus on AWS.

   Strong proficiency in automated provisioning and cloud management.

   Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools, particularly Terraform and Packer.

   Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines and version control systems.

   Strong scripting skills (e.g., Python, Bash) for automation tasks.

   Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.

   Good interpersonal and communication skills for effective collaboration.

   Secondary Skills: 

   AWS certifications (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, AWS Certified Solutions

  Architect).

   Experience with containerization and orchestration tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

   Knowledge of microservices architecture and serverless computing.

   Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools (e.g., CloudWatch, ELK stack).

Subject: your agent now lives inside FlutterFlow
Email Snippet: hey FlutterFlow builders!  two things just shipped that change how you build with AI agents in FlutterFlow.  your agent now lives inside FlutterFlow.  instead of switching between your editor, terminal, and browser, you can now work with your AI agent directly inside the FlutterFlow desktop ap
Full Email Body:
hey FlutterFlow builders!

two things just shipped that change how you build with AI agents in FlutterFlow.

your agent now lives inside FlutterFlow.

instead of switching between your editor, terminal, and browser, you can now work with your AI agent directly inside the FlutterFlow desktop app.

open the AI Agent, connect your existing local setup, and start building without leaving your project.
Open the Desktop app (https://flutterflow.io/desktop)

works with Claude Code and Codex.

plugins for Claude Code (https://github.com/FlutterFlow/flutterflow-claude) and Codex (https://github.com/FlutterFlow/flutterflow-codex) that work in the desktop and terminal apps. setup takes about a minute.

also shipped:

text selection: all text in your app is now selectable via App Settings > General > Display Settings.

canvas screenshots: the MCP tool can now screenshot the Builder canvas so your agent can see your design, no local run required.

PinCode animation: choose entry animation (Slide, Fade, Scale, or None) with custom curve and duration.

let us know what you build.

— the FlutterFlow team

                      Job description    
                    
                    
                      
                    
                    
                       

 We are seeking a Engineer (L2 Support) with 3-5 years of experience to join our technical support team on a Contract-to-Hire basis. The ideal candidate will be responsible for providing technical support, troubleshooting application issues, and assisting in maintaining optimal system performance in AWS cloud environments. This role requires good analytical skills, proficiency with monitoring and logging tools, and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to resolve incidents and support service reliability.

 JOB RESPONSIBILITY
•        Incident Management and Resolution: Respond to and resolve L2 support tickets in a timely manner, ensuring adherence to SLA commitments.
•        AWS Cloud Monitoring: Monitor cloud infrastructure and applications using AWS CloudWatch, Datadog, and other monitoring tools to identify and address performance issues.
•        Log Analysis and Troubleshooting: Analyze application logs, system logs, and error traces to diagnose root causes of incidents and assist in implementing corrective actions.
•        Application Support: Provide troubleshooting support for production applications, working with development teams to resolve technical issues.
•        Linux System Administration: Execute Linux commands and scripts to investigate system behavior, manage processes, and perform routine maintenance tasks.
•        Incident Ticketing and Documentation: Create, update, and manage incident tickets using ticketing systems, ensuring accurate documentation of issues and resolutions.
•        Escalation Management: Escalate complex issues to senior engineers or L3 support teams when necessary, providing detailed context and initial analysis.
•        Performance Monitoring: Assist in identifying performance bottlenecks and work with engineering teams to support optimization efforts.
•        Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with DevOps, development, and infrastructure teams to ensure effective incident resolution.
•        Communication and Reporting: Provide clear and timely updates to stakeholders, including status reports and incident summaries.
•        Proactive Monitoring: Support the setup and maintenance of alerts and dashboards to detect anomalies and prevent potential incidents.
•        Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to internal documentation, runbooks, and knowledge base to support team efficiency.
•        On-call Support: Participate in on-call rotation to provide support coverage for production systems.
•        Continuous Learning: Stay updated with AWS services, monitoring tools, and support best practices to improve technical capabilities.

 QUALIFICATION
B.E/B.Tech in Computer Sciences, IT, Engineering, or related field

 EXPERIENCE
•        3 to 5 years of experience in L2 technical support, application support, or production support roles

 SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

 Technical Skills:
•        Proficiency in AWS Cloud services including EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, CloudWatch, and other core AWS components.
•        Working knowledge of monitoring and observability tools such as AWS CloudWatch, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, or similar platforms.
•        Good log analysis skills using tools like CloudWatch Logs, Splunk, ELK Stack, or other log management solutions.
•        Proficiency in Linux/Unix systems administration, including command-line operations, shell scripting, and basic system troubleshooting.
•        Experience with incident ticketing systems such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Desk, or similar ITSM tools.
•        Application troubleshooting skills across web applications, APIs, and microservices.
•        Basic knowledge of networking concepts, including DNS, load balancing, VPC, and security groups.
•        Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes.
•        Understanding of database systems (SQL and NoSQL) and ability to perform basic query troubleshooting.
•        Experience with scripting languages such as Bash, Python, or PowerShell for automation and troubleshooting.
•        Exposure to containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) is a plus.
•        Understanding of ITIL processes and best practices for incident and problem management.

 Domain Expertise:
•        Incident Management: Understanding of incident lifecycle, severity classification, SLA management, and escalation procedures.
•        Root Cause Analysis: Ability to assist in RCA activities and document findings for preventive measures.
•        Cloud Architecture: Basic understanding of cloud-native architectures and distributed systems troubleshooting.
•        Performance Monitoring: Knowledge of application and infrastructure performance monitoring techniques.

 Professional Competencies:
•        Good problem-solving and analytical skills with the ability to diagnose technical issues systematically.
•        Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, capable of explaining technical issues clearly and providing status updates.
•        Ability to work independently on assigned tickets while seeking guidance when needed for complex issues.
•        Customer-focused approach with commitment to delivering quality support and ensuring user satisfaction.
•        Sense of ownership and accountability, taking responsibility for assigned incidents through resolution.
•        Ability to remain calm and focused during incidents and manage multiple tasks effectively.
•        Willingness to learn and stay current with AWS services, monitoring tools, and industry best practices.
•        Team collaboration skills, working effectively with cross-functional teams including developers and DevOps engineers.
•        Time management skills with the ability to prioritize tasks based on business impact and urgency.
•        Attention to detail in documentation, ensuring accurate incident records and knowledge articles.
•        Flexibility to work in shifts or participate in on-call rotations as required for support coverage.
•        Commitment to continuous improvement and contributing to enhanced support processes.

   Support incident resolution related to deployment pipelines and cloud    infrastructure.

                         Job Title: CI/CD Engineer / DevOps Engineer 

  Job Summary 

 We are seeking a highly motivated CI/CD Engineer to design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in build systems, automation, source code management, artifact repositories, and software quality/security scanning tools. This role requires close collaboration with development, QA, and release teams to streamline software delivery processes and improve engineering productivity.

  Key Responsibilities 

 * Design, implement, and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines for software build, test, and deployment processes.

 * Develop automation solutions using Python and Shell scripting to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual intervention.

 * Create and manage workflow automation using GitHub Actions or Jenkins.

 * Support and optimize build systems for C++, Rust, and other software projects.

 * Configure and maintain build tools such as CMake and Conan for dependency management and build orchestration.

 * Integrate artifact management solutions using JFrog Artifactory.

 * Implement and manage code quality, security, and compliance scanning tools within CI/CD pipelines.

 * Collaborate with development teams to troubleshoot build failures, deployment issues, and pipeline bottlenecks.

 * Continuously improve release processes, build reliability, and deployment automation.

 * Establish CI/CD best practices, standards, and governance across engineering teams.

   Required Skills & Qualifications 

 Programming & Automation

 * Strong proficiency in Python for automation, tooling, and pipeline development.

 * Experience with Shell scripting (Bash/Sh) for system automation and CI/CD integration.

  ### CI/CD Platforms 

 * Hands-on experience with GitHub Actions for workflow automation.

 * Experience with Jenkins for pipeline development and build orchestration.

 * Strong understanding of CI/CD concepts, pipeline design, and release management.

  ### Build Systems 

 * Experience working with C++ build environments.

 * Hands-on experience with CMake and Conan.

 * Exposure to Rust build ecosystem and package management.

New Controls for Agents and Secrets

July 2026

Hi Hemachandiran,

The last few months put AI agents at the center of Pulumi. July was about keeping them, and the secrets and credentials underneath, under control. You can now cap how much Neo spends in a month, sign in to Pulumi Cloud with a passkey, enforce a maximum lifetime on every access token, and preview an ESC change on a real stack before it ships.

Key Product Updates

-

Preview ESC Changes Before They Ship (https://info.pulumi.com/e3t/Ctc/GC+113/cx72f04/VWRpGw4B35BjW8PHxpb4GyGmGW33LWhB5S641XMVmxWK3prCCW8wLKSR6lZ3nGW4zcLc52F6rcpW7P-_7l6lSxFNW3hQLLX622RKBW8mSlRH4hd-ykN629jKtDvgMRW8-Z0zQ13Q0qKW7xC1rz3cvMZ0VDsJdk3J8cVJW67YhzD29JQTvW6nG7sq756wtZW6_2BhQ41HNhVN1b2GGVcJ4HCN13Pk0fmywxyW6D2rrl5w3W4MN2jJ8XJnFx3PW1yN1L55h3Z6GW3sxKlG7GNSbLW6BbdKf2dRdcXW2XXWgJ5Vz_TnW7xV-X05g7849W6cGt4t2tdKs7W8rL4W73M2f6FW7TPxDh27yvfGW8rYgSw2vQGyGN9jQNRgXMK5zW4gMZn14wJjwnW1GCxKJ4mSYRrVqGTNT8j8h8sf504Cn804 )  A new --override-env flag lets you swap in a draft environment and run pulumi preview or pulumi up against it, so a reviewer can test a configuration change on a real stack before it is approved. Reference a draft with @draft:<draft-id>, and layer several overrides at once.

-

Sign in to Pulumi Cloud with Passkeys (https://info.pulumi.com/e3t/Ctc/GC+113/cx72f04/VWRpGw4B35BjW8PHxpb4GyGmGW33LWhB5S641XMVmxWq3prCCW7Y8-PT6lZ3mzW3fYckx86Pgk1W13DFTW7q1HYHW4cJhGj2h-KvGW3kYst58F1kW0VLRbjw1ThSBNW2Z4Fj15CpSr0W6rkTWs66wH-gVXrhDW2SmN0gW1fySg64TrcFrW8Wxkw47z74C7W89tNV28xd0SmN18Ddt_kR9N9W6ynqq44533hXW5XmyDN3KtFGXW5nGnlB31sKcxW8ts6ls8yzqfqW2DwrT17kYnWfW9b9Qyb8mxKGLW3WcMkR2DZh-_V8vRQG2t2G93W1Yq0V16VYh63W4P4JDP8b_F4QW8Cq42h2wLtFTN3vgmR1cMX8JW1LCYzf1zMGssN8BT-h98wctRf1fcr8x04 )  Email and password users can now add a passkey and sign in with a biometric or hardware key. Passkeys bind to Pulumi's domain, so they are phishing-resistant by design and remove the shared-secret risk that comes with passwords.

-

Enforce Access Token Expiry Policies (https://info.pulumi.com/e3t/Ctc/GC+113/cx72f04/VWRpGw4B35BjW8PHxpb4GyGmGW33LWhB5S641XMVmxW63prCCW7lCdLW6lZ3mXN8xTdgpS1L78W6cg7SR8yM7jsW90bxyw6HZl6RN4PHtnfsxLQYW1RPLZZ7YnnZMW6Zn_t348Zx3BN4h4gxBs7lqNW46Rbg-6CmpV6W5MCD3m6W3y-FW73YNvC3LSJFMVyyyht7z1gWsW3dhsDv8hG8QhW8h_CRd7pqMrBW1zGRmx3Wlnx5N1wM1kcpXpMKW2lrLct3w4NKSW8cDRQ06WSNCzN3Ct-swbwFj2W5SSfmP6Vqhf9W1TTYpk1WmxWxW1mCn-K9lzM6qW2YmZmD6X7Kv8W30Gtn93bH5ZNW2fBjzd6K8ZLkf27j3W404 )  Organization admins can now set a maximum lifetime for every token: personal, organization, and team. Compliance is checked on each request, and any token past the limit is rejected with a clear error, so credential rotation is enforced at the platform level.

Spotlight: Usage Limits for Pulumi Neo

Neo can plan and deploy real infrastructure on its own, and now you can put a budget around it. Set a monthly dollar limit for your organization and Neo pauses when it is reached. Add per-member limits so no single person can spend the whole pool, and get email alerts at 50, 80, 95, and 100 percent of the organization threshold. Admins and billing owners get a clear ceiling on AI agent spend without turning the agent off.

Read the announcement → (https://info.pulumi.com/e3t/Ctc/GC+113/cx72f04/VWRpGw4B35BjW8PHxpb4GyGmGW33LWhB5S641XMVmxW63prCCW7lCdLW6lZ3m0W67Jcwb3xsNlBN8wYydyVv1K5V7mVwS6dbw00W3NxmvK4JrqByN1jb2Bvxv56PW6w7PWC4XhCvvW6FJW3s8MY1xYW4XSG7Q6f9G7GW54kWHF835m35W90dDSg57sdDYW2LChb39czbYMW3NFPKq2sFLfZW717d_31_KQKbW2Gzn-v8tZGS8N4L9MklywKr_W4CxMR57SZWG5W5VFcTR8bY8g6W8dmQnS31TTHpW67hRWH5FzcM6W2ftk7r2kWm21W65ssdj4nG6ZlN8RGtK58K83NW3H6wRG8-qmxzN2F5D9sBhM6Mf4H080C04 )

The Standalone ESC CLI Is Retiring (https://info.pulumi.com/e3t/Ctc/GC+113/cx72f04/VWRpGw4B35BjW8PHxpb4GyGmGW33LWhB5S641XMVmxWq3prCCW7Y8-PT6lZ3pkN6QJm_xgjjttN6snps_cLVlvVbYN7K7vVX2VW6_m4Mq49mVdQW7TbB5s8dsxPLW4xf-Df5xVdJTW6gSTFb2yX-0vVnxhBl5-rf1RN12bRX4_lN_GW4bMQc_2sN1zdW88yLSZ6l9XkTW6vtWdF49-69hW3N1kY72Bng09W2wJDQV4NtzKdW3B-xZz7-q1m1W4-BhMq4FFrXZVLXGMb8htg0cV3PLmM8K_k9ZW6lGwcN51Rn-hW8-Ct5Q3sgN8JW8bhvtH6R7VYQW4CHhHy4TdPxxW8j2j778tYRmYW6SNb2k95Vz0xW7Y0Ssl37mcsCW6S86nY3BHxpzf1dqD9604 )  The separate esc CLI has shipped its final release (v0.26.0) and now lives inside the main Pulumi CLI. Replace esc env with pulumi env in your scripts, for example esc env ls becomes pulumi env ls. If you already use the Pulumi CLI, there is nothing to do.

Versioned CLI and SDK Docs (https://info.pulumi.com/e3t/Ctc/GC+113/cx72f04/VWRpGw4B35BjW8PHxpb4GyGmGW33LWhB5S641XMVmxWq3prCCW7Y8-PT6lZ3pZW1Pknq74Fg2fDW7tdY6Q5YQKg5W3_KKHh7pY1F8W8J39Cl17-vbQW6s221411k9_hW7L4CMc2GtL2BW4vXgBb6Hm1jbW468NmQ6dGRWWW2sr9ml94h6XBW7YmSq44j_yJwW46XG3B8jcClrW5XPmtc1XhV4gN849M21gnX9NVqf4ZB4xTXjSV9LwGY76LjkpW8-CLD65HjGC4W7fB1f87BWvp0W6MW7QG4S0_BtW7nHxGC3tmcRBW63wl0s2_fQxPW7NHBtv7CCPkvW1M89tJ7Lz3C1N64WFQk58tlDW4PGtWw4H06l5W7YZ8WB3hGy6BW3wst5J8hXvnkdtBHjs04 )  The docs now have a version picker, so you can read the CLI and SDK reference that matches the release you are running instead of only the latest.

                      Job description    
                    
                    
                      
                    
                    
                       

  Project Role :  Integration Engineer
 Project Role Description :  Provide consultative Business and System Integration services to help clients implement effective solutions. Understand and translate customer needs into business and technology solutions. Drive discussions and consult on transformation, the customer journey, functional/application designs and ensure technology and business solutions represent business requirements.                                                                                                                                                             
 Must have skills :  Infrastructure As Code (IaC)
 Good to have skills :  Python (Programming Language)
Minimum  3  year(s) of experience is required
 Educational Qualification :  15 years full time education

 Summary: 
As an Integration Engineer, a typical day involves engaging closely with clients to offer expert advice on business and system integration challenges. This role requires understanding client requirements thoroughly and translating them into practical technology and business solutions. The day often includes leading discussions on transformation initiatives, mapping out customer journeys, and designing functional and application frameworks that align with business objectives. Collaboration with various stakeholders to ensure that the solutions meet the intended business needs is a key aspect of daily activities, fostering seamless integration and effective implementation.
 

 Roles & Responsibilities: 
- Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
- Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
- Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment of integration strategies with overall business goals.
- Assist in identifying potential risks and propose mitigation strategies during integration projects.
- Support junior team members by sharing knowledge and providing guidance on integration best practices.
 

 Professional & Technical Skills: 
- Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Infrastructure As Code (IaC).
- Good To Have Skills: Experience with Python (Programming Language).
- Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure and automation tools related to Infrastructure As Code.
- Experience in designing, deploying, and managing scalable infrastructure solutions.
- Familiarity with configuration management and orchestration tools.
- Ability to troubleshoot and optimize infrastructure deployments to enhance performance and reliability.
 

 Additional Information: 
- The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Infrastructure As Code (IaC).
- This position is based at our Chennai office.
- A 15 years full time education is required.

Subject: 2 new ways to use AI agents in FlutterFlow
Email Snippet: ** 2 New Ways to Use AI Agents in FlutterFlow ------------------------------------------------------------  Build with Claude Code and Codex right where you already work: a native agent panel in the macOS desktop app, and plugins that connect your agents to FlutterFlow from anywhere. We’ve also a
Full Email Body:
** 2 New Ways to Use AI Agents in FlutterFlow
------------------------------------------------------------

Build with Claude Code and Codex right where you already work: a native agent panel in the macOS desktop app, and plugins that connect your agents to FlutterFlow from anywhere. We’ve also added some additional improvements.


** 1. Native AI Agent in the Desktop App
------------------------------------------------------------

Open the AI agent icon in the macOS app and it connects to the agent setup already on your system.
https://youtu.be/zK8neqREUHc
Download Desktop App (https://flutterflow.io/desktop)


** 2. Claude Code and Codex Plugins
------------------------------------------------------------

Plugins for both agents that work in the desktop and terminal apps. Setup takes about a minute.

Install the plugins:
* Claude Code plugin on GitHub (https://github.com/FlutterFlow/flutterflow-claude)
* Codex plugin on GitHub (https://github.com/FlutterFlow/flutterflow-codex)

https://youtu.be/FBsqQfkrsSY

Documentation
* Claude Code Plugin in FlutterFlow (https://docs.flutterflow.io/flutterflow-cli/claude-code/)
* Codex plugin in FlutterFlow (https://docs.flutterflow.io/flutterflow-cli/codex/)


** Improvements
------------------------------------------------------------
